verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own menu offers a category-organized install catalog: Install > Development for environments, Install > Terminal for terminals, and Install > Windows, plus a curated editor list (VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime, and others). A user reports installing software is easy, and a Super+Space launcher exists. However, the evidence never documents searching or filtering the installable catalog itself; the launcher is only shown opening apps. missing for 10: documented search across the installable app catalog, category filtering beyond fixed menu sections, a broad familiar-app catalog (not just dev tools), search/filter for the community plugin catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration of catalog browsing.
